title: Purchase Invoice — the supplier's bill
description: The buying cycle's settlement step. Both back-references are required, and for the same reason the receipt requires its order: a bill that cites neither the commitment nor the receipt it settles is a journal entry, which the model expresses as a gl-posting instead. net_total and total are optional so a caller may send lines and taxes and let the posting layer derive them, but a total that disagrees with the lines is refused rather than silently preferred.

posting_date.description: The accounting date the ledger rows land in. Optional: the posting layer falls back to transaction_date, never to the wall clock.

against_purchase_order.description: The commitment this bill is against. Required: an uncommitted payable is not a purchase.

against_purchase_receipt.description: The receipt this bill settles. Required: the buying cycle is invoice-after-goods, and the goods arrival is the thing being billed.

total.description: The grand total including taxes. Optional, and cross-checked against the lines when present.

harvest: the purchase invoice field surface (supplier, order and receipt back-references, posting date, taxes, totals)
the settlement step of the buying cycle and the documents it must cite
x-erp-provenance.note: Field and lifecycle shapes from the upstream purchase invoice doctype, re-expressed as our own schema and workflow data. No upstream file was read into this repository; no upstream code, schema or text is copied.
